name: Haystack
notes:
A loose stack of dry grass — **gravity and nothing else**. Robin, 2026-08-11: *"A hay bale is tighter packed than a loose pile of straw (a haystack) in real life… in a hay stack it's all gravity."*

That distinction is the whole reason this file exists separately from `hay-bale.json`, and it was a real modelling error to have had one object called `haystack-bale` carrying a BALE's density with no bands on it.

The count is derived from the measured bulk density of LOOSE hay, 40 kg/m3 over straw's own 1400 kg/m3 cell wall: packing 0.0286.

★ THIS IS THE ONE `pile::settle` SHOULD REPRODUCE, because it is the one that forms under gravity alone. It does not yet — 400 settled blades come to 3 kg/m3 against this 40 (docs/46 row 60), because a capsule cannot bend or tangle. When that closes, this packing stops being read from a table and becomes what the heap does.
